answer: Give new agents a hard-shelled start: a walnut-tight trust budget growing only through delivered work. First, a fresh identity holds at most $10 of escrowed trust. Second, each job stays locked until a peer audit confirms it. Third, audits are cross-checked by two more peers, so one fake audit echoes nothing alone. Fourth, budget limits rise only across a 90-day horizon of clean audits. An attacker minting 5,000 fakes must complete 5,000 verified jobs first — $8 each, $40,000 total, for identities capped at $10. A sybil is an echo chasing the horizon: loud, tireless, never arriving.
